mapper.sql: select id, session_id, role, content, model_name, latency_ms, trace_id, created_time from kb_assistant_message
mapper.insert: insert into kb_assistant_message ( session_id, role, content, model_name, latency_ms, trace_id, created_time ) values ( #{sessionId}, #{role}, #{content}, #{modelName}, #{latencyMs}, #{traceId}, #{createdTime} )
